pages.title: Singularity Cluster
pages.text: Nine singularities condensed into one, when there are too many to hold.

When a pack has so many singularities that one recipe cannot hold them, nine at a time are condensed into a $(item)Singularity Cluster$() on the Extreme Assembly Table - and nine clusters into a Hypercluster, and so on. The Omniscience Catalyst then asks for the clusters.
